COUNTY GOVERNMENT OF MACHAKOS
Department of Agriculture advisory, 2026 long rains.
Farmers in Kangundo, Matungulu and Tala wards collect subsidised fertiliser at the Kangundo NCPB depot.
Farmers in Machakos Town and Mavoko wards collect at the Machakos NCPB depot.
Depots open Monday to Saturday from 8 am. Collection requires the allocation SMS and national ID.
The 2026 long rains distribution in Machakos county started on 15 February 2026.
